  [modV : _root_.Module ℂ V] (act : ↥Reduction.SL →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ End ℂ V) (x y h : ↥Reduction.SL) (v0 : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  0 ≤ l ∧ l < ↑p →
    Reduction.highestModule l act x h →
      Reduction.chevalley x y h →
        v0 ≠ 0 ∧ (act x) v0 = 0 ∧ (act h) v0 = ↑l • v0 →
          Reduction.strings l (act x) (act y) (act h) v0 →
            (∀ (r i : ℕ),
                i ≤ l.toNat →
                  r ≤ i →
                    (act x ^ r) (Reduction.e (act y) v0 i) =
                      ↑((l.toNat - i + 1).ascFactorial r) • Reduction.e (act y) v0 (i - r)) ∧
              (∀ (r i : ℕ), i ≤ l.toNat → i < r → (act x ^ r) (Reduction.e (act y) v0 i) = 0) ∧
                ∀ (r i : ℕ),
                  (act y ^ r) (Reduction.e (act y) v0 i) = ↑((i + 1).ascFactorial r) • Reduction.e (act y) v0 (i + r)
